root.label: Percutaneous vertebral augmentation for osteoporotic VCF is medically reasonable and necessary
root.source_quote: PVA (percutaneous vertebroplasty (PVP) or percutaneous kyphoplasty (PKP)) is covered in patients who qualify based on the following criteria

children.label: Acute or subacute osteoporotic VCF confirmed by advanced imaging
Osteoporotic VCF (T1-L5), acute (< 6 wk) or subacute (6-12 wk) from symptom onset
children.source_quote: Acute (<6 weeks) or subacute (6-12 weeks) osteoporotic VCF

children.label: Advanced imaging shows bone marrow edema on MRI or bone-scan/SPECT/CT uptake
children.source_quote: bone marrow edema on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or bone-scan/single photon emission computed tomography (SPECT)/computed tomography (CT) uptake

children.label: Hospitalized with severe pain (NRS or VAS >= 8)
children.source_quote: Hospitalized with severe pain (Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) or Visual Analog Scale (VAS) pain score ≥8)

children.label: Non-hospitalized: moderate-severe pain despite optimal non-surgical care, and a qualifying course
Pain NRS or VAS >= 5 despite optimal non-surgical management
children.source_quote: moderate-to-severe pain (NRS or VAS ≥5) despite optimal non-surgical management (NSM)

children.label: Worsening pain, or stable pain with two structural/functional features
At least 2 of: height-loss progression, > 25% height reduction, kyphosis, RDQ > 17
children.source_quote: Stable-to-improved pain (but NRS or VAS still ≥5) (with ≥ 2 of the following

children.label: Progression of vertebral body height loss
children.source_quote: Progression of vertebral body height loss

children.label: More than 25% vertebral body height reduction
Severe functional impact: Roland Morris Disability Questionnaire > 17
children.source_quote: Severe impact of VCF on daily functioning (Roland Morris Disability Questionnaire (RDQ) >17

children.label: Referred for bone density evaluation and osteoporosis treatment program
children.source_quote:
should be referred for evaluation of bone mineral density (BMD) and osteoporosis education for subsequent treatment as indicated.

- All patients with VCF should be instructed to take part in an osteoporosis prevention/treatment program

children.label: No absolute contraindication (pain not from the VCF, osteomyelitis/discitis/infection, pregnancy)
children.source_quote:
Current back pain is not primarily due to the identified acute or subacute VCF(s)

  - Osteomyelitis, discitis or active systemic or surgical site infection

  - Pregnancy

excluded.reason: Relative contraindications are clinical judgment, not a gate; surfaced by the payer adversary.

excluded.quote: osteolytic vertebral metastatic disease or myeloma
excluded.reason: Separate malignant indication; v1 benchmark covers osteoporotic VCF.
